content.text: I will start with a disconnected device and a visual inspection.

steps.say: Disconnect the headphones from every device before inspecting the cable.
steps.show: Show the disconnected plug and cable.
steps.check: Check that the plug is disconnected.

steps.say: Inspect the cable near the plug for visible damage.
steps.show: Show the cable near the plug.
steps.check: Look for split insulation or a loose connector.
steps.safety: Stop if the repair needs unfamiliar tools.
